'''796 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Great Peace of the Republic]] era. In this period of [[Time/Legends|time]], Republic [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] opened the previously unexplored [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and broadened Republic territory into areas of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that were then considered to be part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Around 796 BBY, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Following 796 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Yoda went on to become the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Order, serving as its leader.

==Proem==
The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] saw the end of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict known as the [[New Sith Wars]], a thousand years of fighting between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the two major [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-using]] factions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As the war ended, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was left in ruins and in need of reorganization, a restructuring carried out via the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], a collection of reforms enacted by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]].<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The reform codified the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the winning faction of the war, as a branch of the Republic's [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]].<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], a [[Yoda's species/Legends|green-skinned]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]], was born in [[896 BBY/Legends|896 BBY]].<ref name="jvs">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> In the following years, he was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of the Force and became a Jedi.<ref name="negtc" />

==The galaxy in 796 BBY==
The year 796 BBY was also known as 2,857 after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] (ATC),<ref name="YearTC" /> a peace agreement that brought an end to the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="atlas" /> In addition, 796 BBY was the same as 204 after the Ruusan Reformation<ref name="YearRuu" /> and 761 before the [[Great ReSynchronization]] (BrS), a year-notation system established in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]].<ref name="YearGrS" /> More than two hundred years before 796 BBY, the Ruusan Reformation became the stating point of a new era, the [[Great Peace of the Republic]].<ref name="tcswe-era">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}}</ref> During this [[Time/Legends|time]] period, Republic [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] opened the previously unexplored [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of the galaxy, and then-designated [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] portions of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] were charted and settled, broadening the territory of the Republic.<ref name="atlas" /> Around 796 BBY, Yoda became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] of the Jedi Order at one hundred years of age.<ref name="negtc" />

==Impact==
During the Great Peace of the Republic, which lasted for nearly [[22 BBY/Legends|eight hundred more years]], the Galactic Republic continued expanding its territory. In the following years, [[Galactic economy|economic forces]] acquired more and more power in the galaxy, as companies bought [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] and established the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="nec" /> Over the next eight centuries, Yoda trained countless [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentices]] to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knighthood]]. His many years of contribution to the Order gained him a seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Eventually, he ascended to become the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Order,<ref name="negtc" /> serving as the leader of all Jedi and thus turning into the "face" of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and the embodiment of the Order.<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

==Notable events==
*Yoda became a Master of the Jedi Order. {{Circa}}<ref name="negtc" />

==Behind the scenes==
The year 796 BBY was only indirectly mentioned in [[Daniel Wallace]]'s [[2002]] ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' reference book, which stated that Yoda was one hundred years old when he became a Jedi Master.<ref name="negtc" /> Other sources, such as the [[2007]] [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']], stated that Yoda was born in 896 BBY, thus indicating that he became a Master around 796 BBY.<ref name="jvs" />
